text: ADD dev-mode check that rejects collection names that contain `--` with the error `UT9`. The Dexie.js and localStorage RxStorage join the database name, the collection name, and the schema version with `--`, so with such a name two different databases used the same physical store (for example database `app--staging` with collection `todos` and database `app` with collection `staging--todos`). Nothing changes without the dev-mode plugin
